questions.content: You are a member of a Music Club. You received this email from the club administrator. Your music club is planning to hold a concert. The club wants members to come up with suggestions to attract both young and old people to participate
questions.suggestion:
THÂN MẬT:

How are you?

I am writing to tell you about recent news from the club. Did you know that the club is planning a concert?

I was so excited when I heard about the news.

I will write a letter to the manager. What should I write? Your input would mean a lot to me.

Drop me a line soon.

Bye for now,

Mia


TRANG TRỌNG:

Dear Sir,

I hope this email finds you well. My full name is Nguyen Mai Anh, and I have been a member of the Music Club for more than one year.

I am writing to express my feelings and give my suggestions regarding your previous email.

According to the announcement, the club is planning a concert. Besides, suggestions are needed to attract both young and old participants.

To be honest, I was absolutely thrilled at first because many members had been waiting for this event for quite a time.

From my perspective, I would recommend that the club include featuring classic folk songs because these resonate with elderly members while introducing traditions to the youth. In addition, the club should consider hiring a venue that is easily accessed by local people as this is of great importance so that older people won’t have any problem with commuting.

I look forward to hearing your response if my recommendations are accepted.

Best regards,

Nguyen Mai Anh

Hy vọng email này đến tay Quý ông trong tình trạng tốt. Tên đầy đủ của tôi là Nguyễn Mai Anh, và tôi đã là thành viên của Câu lạc bộ Âm Nhạc hơn một năm.

From my perspective, I would recommend that the club ask Mr. Jones to include some new photos and practical gardening tips that he didn’t share last time. In addition, the club should consider adding an interactive Q&A session at the end to make the talk more interesting and useful for everyone.

I look forward to hearing your response if my recommendations are accepted.

Best regards,

Nguyen Mai Anh
